segments.title: Some otters hold hands to SLEEP
segments.say: Some sea otters hold paws while they sleep.

segments.title: So they don't drift away
segments.say: It keeps them from drifting apart in the open ocean.

segments.title: Groups called RAFTS
segments.say: They rest in groups called rafts, to stay safe and warm.

segments.title: Or wrap up in kelp
segments.say: Others wrap themselves in kelp, like a seatbelt.

segments.title: No blubber, just fur
segments.say: They have no blubber. Thick fur keeps them warm.
